definitions: A graphical user interface element that, when clicked or hovered over, displays an animation and typically indicates an action to add, expand, or show more information.
A visual symbol, often a cross or plus sign, that is designed with motion to signify an addition or expansion within a digital interface.
examples: Click the Animated Plus Icon to add a new item.
The Animated Plus Icon transformed into a minus sign upon expansion.
Users found the Animated Plus Icon intuitive for creating new entries.
